prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE fine-line architectural atlas illustration for 访古. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its refined sparse delicate black contours and generous blank space. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Draw the actual named building from it, preserving silhouette, visible bays, eaves, tiers, openings, roof type and proportions. Create sparse BLACK ink contours on flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Interior surfaces stay pure white too. No shading, grey fill, hatching, texture, colour, cast shadows, gradients, halo, checkerboard, text, labels, watermark or borders. Remove people, foliage, modern equipment, signage and neighbouring buildings. Complete whole building and base with 10% margins, verticals vertical, minimal perspective. Subject: 西安鼓楼. wide seven-bay drum tower on a long brick platform, three eave lines and long hipped-gabled roof, central arched passage; no invented front double stairs. One building only. Use a portrait canvas for pagodas and landscape for halls. Entire apex, eaves and base must be uncut.
